project_goal: Showcase Faizan Ahmad's video editing expertise and attract new clients through an engaging, professional portfolio website.
target_users: Potential corporate clients seeking commercial video edits
Independent musicians and bands needing music video production
Filmmakers and documentary producers looking for post‑production services
YouTube creators and content creators requiring channel editing
functional_requirements: Responsive hero section with headline, sub‑headline, and CTA button
Embedded showreel modal with autoplay/pause controls and fallback poster image
Filterable project grid (e.g., Commercial, Music Video, Documentary, YouTube) with hover overlay preview
Project detail lightbox featuring before‑after clips, software badges (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects), and client testimonial snippet
Dynamic quote estimator form that captures project type, duration, and budget range
Contact inquiry form with validation, anti‑spam honeypot, and success confirmation modal
Integrated Google Maps embed for studio location (optional)
Social media icon links opening in new tabs
Sticky back‑to‑top button and smooth scroll navigation
visual_requirements: Bold sans‑serif heading font (e.g., Montserrat Bold) and clean body font (e.g., Inter Regular)
Generous vertical spacing (64px between sections) and consistent 24px grid gutters
Card‑style project thumbnails with subtle drop‑shadow and hover scale effect
Micro‑animations for button hover, modal fade‑in, and grid filter transition
accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, and focus indicators
All images and video thumbnails include descriptive alt text
ARIA labels for interactive elements (modals, filters, form fields)
Focus ring visible with at least 3 px thickness and sufficient contrast
Skip‑to‑content link at top of page
usability_requirements: Clear top navigation with sticky header: Home, About, Services, Portfolio, Testimonials, Contact
Primary CTA (e.g., “Request a Quote”) prominent in hero and sticky footer
Logical information hierarchy: hero → value proposition → services → portfolio → testimonials → contact
Form fields grouped logically with inline error messages
Consistent button styling and placement to guide user flow
compliance_requirements: No dark patterns; all consent dialogs are optional and clearly labeled
Transparent privacy policy link in footer
Cookie notice complying with GDPR/CCPA if tracking scripts are added later
originality_requirements: Custom video‑thumbnail mosaic layout instead of standard grid
Animated SVG logo reveal on page load
Unique section divider using subtle motion graphics tied to editing theme
technical_constraints: Modular CSS3 using variables and BEM naming convention
Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) for interactivity; no frameworks or libraries
Asset optimization: WebP images, MP4/H.264 video for showreel
content_requirements: Hero headline: “Faizan Ahmad – Masterful Video Editing for Visionaries”
Sub‑headline: “Turning raw footage into cinematic stories that captivate audiences.”
Value proposition bullet points: “Fast turnaround • Creative storytelling • Industry‑grade color grading”
Section copy for Services: “Commercials, Music Videos, Documentaries, YouTube Edits – tailored to your brand’s voice.”
Portfolio section intro: “A curated selection of my recent work.”
Testimonial snippet format: “[Client Name], [Company] – ‘Faizan delivered beyond expectations…’”
Contact CTA: “Ready to elevate your project? Get a free quote today.”
explicit_constraints: Use only pure HTML5, modular CSS3 variables, and vanilla ES6+ JavaScript as stated in technical constraints.
implicit_requirements: Responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
Fast page load (<3 seconds on typical 3G connection)
SEO‑friendly markup: semantic headings, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags
Smooth micro‑interactions for hover, scroll, and modal actions
acceptance_criteria: All listed functional features operate without errors on latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge
WCAG 2.1 AA audit passes with no violations
Page load time under 3 seconds on a simulated 3G network (Lighthouse score >90)
Responsive layout passes breakpoint tests at 320 px, 768 px, and 1440 px
Contact and quote forms submit data and display success confirmation
Showreel modal plays video smoothly and can be closed with keyboard ESC
